subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin experienced a sudden episode of screaming, laughing, and weeping, lasting ten minutes, after which he claimed no memory of the event but was fine. He later volunteered to climb the cavern roof to cross a gorge, overheard a bet about his success, tied a rope around his waist, and completed the climb — only to be attacked by hidden crossbowmen on the other side. He survived the fight and declared the group no longer owed Jimjar money.
source_quote: I have no idea what happened. But I am fine now.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar observed Thorin’s madness and remarked that in Sloobludop, the archpriest Ploopploopeen — a follower of the Sea Mother — could help. Shuushar defended the simplicity of the name 'Ploopploopeen' and expressed confusion at Grygum’s reaction.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother, and she will be most welcoming of my awakening to the end of our people’s madness.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum dismissed the name 'Ploopploopeen' as a tongue twister, prompting Shuushar to correct him. When the group turned left into a massive cavern, Grygum was about to speak again but was interrupted by the environment.
source_quote: That’s quite a bit of tongue twister.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir initially believed he could not cross a bottomless gorge without flight or climbing ability, but then realized the cavern ceiling allowed passage. He later questioned whether to dispose of the bandits’ corpses due to ecological and tracking concerns, ultimately sided with Buppido’s view, and collected Nilhogg's nose mushrooms for their enhanced olfactory properties.
source_quote: If only I could fly, I could get across. But I don’t, and there is no way to climb across it.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido was emphatic that leaving the bandits’ corpses would leave a trail usable by trackers. His conviction influenced Zalthir’s decision to drop the bodies into the bottomless gorge.
source_quote: (No direct quote — action-driven conviction)

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar convinced Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait to join the group with a promise of 20 gold. He made a bet with Grygum about Thorin’s climb, celebrated the discovery of a tinderbox, and was the one the group owed money to — until Thorin declared they no longer did.
source_quote: That’s the spirit. He makes it, or doesn’t it?

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth, a shield dwarf, is a vital forager and track-hider whose skills have kept the group alive. She finds Thorin’s connection to giants off-putting due to the lingering devastation of the War of the Giants, and remains unconvinced by his claim that 'they were different giants.' She is now indispensable to the group.
source_quote: But they were different giants!

subject: Stool
fact: Stool, a young Myconid, identified a mushroom as a Nilhogg's nose, explaining its effects: it enhances smell, making good scents more vivid and bad scents painfully intense. Zalthir collected several.
source_quote: That’s a cool mushroom! You can eat it, but it won’t fill you up. But after eating it, you can smell better and find good mushrooms and other smells. It’s like the smells become so much more. But if you smell a bad smell, it hurts you a lot more.

subject: Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait
fact: The two curious goblins were recruited by Jimjar with a promise of 20 gold. They noticed the Faerzress’s magic altering the colors around them, and were affected by its eerie properties.
source_quote: (No direct quote — observational role)

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir was particularly affected by the Faerzress’s eerie magic, though no specific action or dialogue is recorded beyond his reaction.
source_quote: (No direct quote — sensory reaction)

subject: Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is a location associated with the archpriest Ploopploopeen, a follower of the Sea Mother. Shuushar believes she can help those affected by the madness of their people’s end.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother, and she will be most welcoming of my awakening to the end of our people’s madness.

subject: Velkynvelve
fact: The Drow of Velkynvelve are now almost forgotten by the group, indicating their prior threat or relevance has faded into insignificance.
source_quote: The Drow of Velkynvelve is now almost forgotten.

subject: bandits
fact: A group of desperate bandits, dressed in mixed armor and clothing, armed with scimitars and crossbows, attacked Thorin on the far side of the gorge. They had clearly been in the Underdark for some time. They were killed in a short, brutal fight.
source_quote: (No direct quote — combatants)

subject: Ripplebark
fact: Ripplebark is a fungus found in the Underdark with a rotten-fresh appearance. It is edible raw, can be roasted to enhance its nutty flavor, and when scorched or burnt, turns black but remains edible. It can also neutralize disease germs.
source_quote: Despite its rotten fresh appearance, is entirely edible in its raw state and could be roasted to improve its nutty flavor.

subject: Waterorbs
fact: Waterorbs are fungi growing in shallow Underdark water. When mature, they are bulbous, larger than a human head. When squeezed, they yield about a gallon of potable water. The husk is bland, chewy, and edible, and the orb can be used to store water.
source_quote: The Waterorb is a fungus that grows in the Underdark in shallow water. When mature, it was bulbous in shape and bigger than a human head. If squeezed and wrung out, it yields about a gallon of potable water.

subject: Nilhogg's nose
fact: Nilhogg's nose is a mushroom that, when eaten, enhances the sense of smell — making pleasant scents more vivid and unpleasant ones painfully intense. It does not provide nourishment. Zalthir collected several.
source_quote: You can eat it, but it won’t fill you up. But after eating it, you can smell better and find good mushrooms and other smells. It’s like the smells become so much more. But if you smell a bad smell, it hurts you a lot more.

subject: water bladders
fact: Water bladders were recovered from the corpses of the bandits and identified by Zalthir as vital adventuring gear.
source_quote: Zalthir is pleased to discover many vital pieces of adventuring gear on the corpses, the most important of which are water bladders.

subject: tinderbox
fact: Jimjar is excited about the discovery of a tinderbox, claiming toasted Ripplebark is the best thing in the Underdark.
source_quote: Toasted Ripplebark, the best thing in the Underdark.

subject: the bottomless gorge
fact: A massive, bottomless gorge blocks passage in a cavern. Zalthir initially believed it was impassable without flight, but realized the cavern ceiling allowed climbing over it. The bodies of the bandits were dropped into it.
source_quote: Zalthir mutters, 'If only I could fly, I could get across. But I don’t, and there is no way to climb across it.'

subject: the Faerzress-infused tunnels
fact: The tunnels and caves are rich in the Faerzress’s eerie magic. Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait noticed the colors were different than usual, and Sethir was particularly affected.
source_quote: This part of the journey takes you through tunnels and caves rich in the Faerzress's eerie magic.

subject: debate over corpse disposal
fact: A massive debate erupted over whether to leave or dispose of the bandits’ corpses. Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy believed monsters would hinder pursuers; Shuushar dismissed tracking from ecological disturbance as absurd; Buppido insisted it would leave a trail. Zalthir sided with Buppido, and the bodies were dropped into the gorge.
source_quote: What to do with corpses is a significant ecological, Philosophical, and existential problem in the Underdark.

subject: Thorin’s climb and bet
fact: Grygum bet with Jimjar that Thorin would make the climb. Thorin overheard, tied a rope around his waist, and climbed to the cavern roof and across the gorge. He shouted that they no longer owed Jimjar money, unaware of the hidden attackers.
source_quote: Wanna make a bet? ... Makes it.

subject: Thorin’s madness episode
fact: Thorin suddenly screamed, laughed, and wept for ten minutes. No one could determine if it was PTSD, Underdark stress, or a religious ritual. He recovered and claimed no memory of the event.
source_quote: I have no idea what happened. But I am fine now.

subject: 9th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The events of Thorin’s madness, the climb, the bandit fight, corpse disposal, and Nilhogg's nose discovery occurred on this date.
source_quote: 9th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: 10th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The next day, Eldeth reflected on the dark, her foraging skills, and the fading memory of the Drow of Velkynvelve. She also confronted Thorin about his ties to giants.
source_quote: Another day in the dark,

subject: Ploopploopeen’s potential aid
fact: Shuushar’s mention of Ploopploopeen, the archpriest of Sloobludop, introduces a possible future contact who may help those affected by the madness of their people’s end — an unresolved thread.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother, and she will be most welcoming of my awakening to the end of our people’s madness.

subject: giant civil war legacy
fact: Eldeth’s lingering trauma over the War of the Giants and Thorin’s defense of 'different giants' suggests an unresolved ideological and emotional rift regarding giant heritage that may resurface.
source_quote: The War of the Giants that happened after the War of the Dragons ended in a peculiar stalemate.

subject: Faerzress-induced sensory distortion
fact: The Faerzress’s magic altered colors for Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait and deeply affected Sethir — an ongoing environmental mystery that may influence future perception or sanity.
source_quote: Yuk Yuk and Spiderbait find the colors somehow different than they are used to. And Sethir seems particularly affected.

subject: 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The group wakes up to the sounds of screaming.
source_quote: The group wakes up to the sounds of screaming.

subject: Yuk Yuk
fact: Yuk Yuk is dead, his throat cut with a shortsword.
source_quote: Spiderbait is staring at the ground at his friend Yuk Yuk. The rest of the group examines the ground, and there is the corpse of Yuk Yuk, his throat cut with a blade.

subject: shortsword wound
fact: A fatal wound inflicted by a shortsword, capable of being delivered by any member of the group.
source_quote: Grygum examines the cut and notes, 'It’s a shortsword. Any one of us could have done it.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is analyzing the murder weapon and speculating on the suspect pool.
source_quote: Grygum examines the cut and notes, 'It’s a shortsword. Any one of us could have done it.'

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait discovered the body of Yuk Yuk and is visibly shaken.
source_quote: Spiderbait is staring at the ground at his friend Yuk Yuk.

subject: murder mystery
fact: The identity of Yuk Yuk’s killer is unknown, and all group members are potential suspects.
source_quote: Grygum examines the cut and notes, 'It’s a shortsword. Any one of us could have done it.'

subject: group sleep interruption
fact: The group is silenced by others while attempting to sleep after a debate.
source_quote: The two of them are told to be quiet by the rest of the group as it tries to sleep.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido correctly predicted the arrival of the bandits and insists on traveling to Gracklstugh first.
source_quote: Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first and suggests they can purchase the equipment they need to make it to Blingdenstone.

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir insists on investigating the lost temple and observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous than through tunnels.
source_quote: Sethir insists they should check out the lost temple and find the treasure. Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous than traveling in tunnels.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop but may assist with travel on the Darklake.
source_quote: Shuushar says he has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop but may be willing to help with travel in the Darklake.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is mildly disinterested in Blingdenstone and bets on finding monsters in the tomb.
source_quote: Jimjar is mildly disinterested. Jimjar mutters, 'It’s a lost tomb; of course, we will; the better question is -what kind of monsters-.'

subject: Topsy and Turvy
fact: Topsy and Turvy find the name 'Blingdenstone' off-putting.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy find the name off-putting.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is enjoying toasted Ripplebark and initiates a bet about monsters in the tomb.
source_quote: Grygum, enjoying the taste of toasted Ripplebark, asks Jimjar, 'Wanna bet that we’ll find monsters in the tomb?'

subject: bet on tomb monsters
fact: Grygum and Jimjar agree to a bet on the type of monsters found in the tomb, with skeletons and zombies as the chosen wager.
source_quote: ‘Undead?’ ‘Boring.’ ‘Skeletons and Zombies?’ ‘I’ll take that bet.’

subject: bandits of truce
fact: A group of bandits arrived under a flag of truce, offering information about escaping the Underdark, and claimed to have gotten lost in a dungeon.
source_quote: A group of bandits arrive under the flag of truce, offering information about how to get out of the Underdark. The bandit leader explains, 'We were exploring a dungeon and made one too many wrong turns, ending up deeper into the ground than we wanted to.'

subject: Grygum, Eldeth, and Zalthir
fact: Grygum, Eldeth, and Zalthir recognize the bandits’ story as a fabrication.
source_quote: Grygum, Eldeth, and Zalthir realize that the story is a fabrication and that the details are not that important.

subject: bandit information
fact: The bandit leader offers information that the best escape route is through Blingdenstone, in exchange for food.
source_quote: He offers the information for food. The deal is agreed upon, and he shares with him that the best chance of escape is through the town of Blingdenstone.

subject: the bandit leader
fact: The bandit leader claims to have gotten lost in a dungeon, but his story is recognized as false.
source_quote: The bandit leader explains, 'We were exploring a dungeon and made one too many wrong turns, ending up deeper into the ground than we wanted to.'

subject: the escaped bandit
fact: The escaped bandit was killed and looted; he was the one who escaped from the ambush near the gorge.
source_quote: The escapees loot the corpse, and as they loot them, they realize he is the bandit who escaped from the ambush near the gorge.

subject: toadstool spore cloud
fact: A cluster of squat toadstools, when uprooted or heavily damaged, emits a 15-ft radius cloud of spores that causes confusion-like poisoning.
source_quote: No. If it is heavily damaged or killed by uprooting, it spews a cloud of spores out to a radius of 15 ft. All those within the cloud may be poisoned for about a minute and, when poisoned, are affected by the same effects of a confusion spell.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin inquired whether the toadstools could be eaten.
source_quote: Thorin asks if they can be eaten.

subject: she
fact: She identified the toadstools and later linked their spore effect to the corpse of the bandit.
source_quote: She shouts, 'Tinmmasks.' She looks at a corpse, 'that’s what happened to that guy.'

subject: lost temple
fact: Sethir insists on investigating the lost temple to find treasure, suggesting it is a potential destination.
source_quote: Sethir insists they should check out the lost temple and find the treasure.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is identified as the best escape route from the Underdark, though some find the name off-putting.
source_quote: He shares with him that the best chance of escape is through the town of Blingdenstone. Topsy and Turvy find the name off-putting.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is proposed by Buppido as the first destination to acquire equipment before proceeding to Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first and suggests they can purchase the equipment they need to make it to Blingdenstone.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is observed as a less treacherous travel route than subterranean tunnels.
source_quote: Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous than traveling in tunnels. Shuushar says he has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop but may be willing to help with travel in the Darklake.

subject: Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is a location beyond which Shuushar refuses to travel.
source_quote: Shuushar says he has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop...

subject: debate fatigue
fact: The group ends a prolonged debate on travel routes and falls asleep.
source_quote: The debate continues, but eventually, everyone tires of it and falls asleep.
